race.comment: CIGAR MAN (2) is in good touch and goes on top, having won a BM62 over 2412m here before being beaten a long neck by TRUSTY BANDIT in harder mid-week company over a similar trip. The drop back to 2200m is suitable, he has already won around this distance and the apprentice claim gives him a pull at the weights that could prove decisive. TARAVIA (5) has been narrowly beaten at his past two, and his record over this trip makes him a serious danger. Only has to hold his form to be right there again and Thompson sticking is another good push. EMPRESS ASPEN (12) was only beaten a nose at the Sunny Coast and gets in at a featherweight with the rise in grade. A prior win at Doomben and a reliable distance profile puts him right in the mix. CASTELLO GRANDE (8) has been hitting the line hard and could relish this rise in trip.
